verdict.rationale: Ashby documents an official MCP Server that exposes live recruiting context (candidates, applications, jobs, offers, etc.) to MCP-compatible AI clients like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor, respecting existing Ashby permissions. This is a first-party, product-side MCP server offering (not a coding-agent client role), so the axis applies and is documented directly. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's real-world behavior beyond vendor announcement.
